verses.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the kehillah of the Thessalonians in ELOHIM our Father and Adonai Yeshua Mashiach:
Grace to you and peace from ELOHIM our Father and Adonai Yeshua Mashiach.
We ought always to give thanks to ELOHIM for you, brothers, as is right, because your faith is growing abundantly, and the love of every one of you for one another is increasing.
Therefore we ourselves boast about you in the kehillot of ELOHIM for your steadfastness and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions that you are enduring.
This is evidence of those who do the will of ELOHIM judgment of ELOHIM, that you may be considered worthy of the kingdom of ELOHIM, for which you are also suffering—
since indeed ELOHIM considers it in accordance with covenant faithfulness to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
and to grant relief to you who are afflicted as well as to us, when Adonai Yeshua is revealed from the skies with his mighty angels
in flaming fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know ELOHIM and on those who do not obey the gospel of our Adonai Yeshua.
They will suffer the punishment of eternal destruction, away from the presence of Adonai and from the glory of his might,
when he comes on that day to be glorified in his set-apart ones, and to be marveled at among all who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.
To this end we always pray for you, that our ELOHIM may make you worthy of his calling and may fulfill every resolve for good and every work of faith by his power,
so that the name of our Adonai Yeshua may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our ELOHIM and Adonai Yeshua Mashiach.
